metric: MSE of cell-averaged RGB over the active image
measured_against: scaled source before Spectrum palette quantization

colour_comparison.rgb_sample_bound: Each averaged and physical 2x2 RGB error <= source monochrome reference +64 MSE/component
colour_comparison.chroma_sample_bound: Each physical 2x2 opponent-colour error <= neutral reference +16 MSE/component
colour_comparison.chroma_metric: Squared R-G and B-G differences; not a perceptual grade
